standard-dialogue.player: What are you doing up here?

standard-dialogue.npc: Why, I'm ensuring everyone stays well fed and hydrated, of course! Fighting monsters is hard work, as I'm sure you know.
Say, when was the last time you drank some water?

standard-dialogue.player: Uh, I suppose I am a bit thirsty...

standard-dialogue.npc: Off you go and refresh yourself! Don't want you collapsing in front of the Hueycoatl now, do we?

using-items-on-marla-egg.npc: Oh, thank you! I'll make good use of this most versatile, nutritious and delicious ingredient!

using-items-on-marla-damp-egg.npc: We were warned not to trust your kind, and I can see why.
What a horrible thing to do to someone.
And to mar the egg in the first place?! I'm shaken to my core!

using-items-on-marla-damp-egg.text: The dwarf is too busy cooking and grumbling to hear you.

using-items-on-marla-redberry-antelope.npc: Weird, isn't it? Definitely not what I would consider gourmet cooking, but to each their own...
